incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate observed on /v1/generate (us-east-1) — 5xx spike > 30% over 5m. paging oncall: @irene-oncall :rotating_light:

irene-oncall: reading the alert now, joining call. Sharing initial context: customers complaining of 502s and timeouts.

sam-sre: hey, can you confirm if this is limited to one model or route? I see retries flooding the queue.

irene-oncall: quick `curl` from edge shows 502 with "model serving error". Logs show increasing KV cache misses and oom-ish traces on runtime nodes. Pasting snippet:```
2026-03-15T20:41:12Z ERROR runtime.kvcache: failed to allocate 0x1e00000 bytes
2026-03-15T20:41:13Z WARN runtime.queue: request throttled due to memory pressure
```

mike-product: any customer-impact list yet? I flagged top 5 paying customers on the dashboard. Lucy, can you confirm billing-impacted tenants?

lucy-opsbot: auto-check: tenants with >0.5% increase in 5xx: AcmeCorp, BrightFin, Tutorly. Estimated affected requests: ~12k over last 10m. Notified account reps.

sam-sre: root cause hypothesis: a recent model rollout to a quantized variant caused memory fragmentation under long-seq workloads. Suggest switching routing to fallback model variant and draining affected runtime pool.

irene-oncall: agree. I'm going to update routing policy for the next 50 requests to fallback `gptx-small-v2` in us-east-1. Doing now.

incident-bot: ACTION by irene-oncall: set routing -> fallback `gptx-small-v2` for region us-east-1 (auto-ttl 15m).

irene-oncall: routed. Error rate dropping to ~8% in the last 2m. Latency normalized. Starting a live mitigation note: we should schedule a post-incident review and map remediation to backlog.

mike-product: can we capture customer impact statement for postmortem? Short bullets will do.

irene-oncall: drafting: - incident window: 20:41-21:05 UTC - root cause: model variant memory fragmentation during long-sequence inference - customer impact: increased 5xx for top-enterprise tenants, ~0.7% request loss for affected customers, no data exfiltration - mitigation: routing to fallback model, draining affected runtimes, temporary autoscale increase.

sam-sre: capture timeline and logs. I'll pull pod-level heap metrics and allocation traces.

lucy-opsbot: scheduling: created postmortem thread in #postmortems and tentative meeting at 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.company/incident-1812345678

mike-product: thanks. For action items, we need owners and sizes so we can prioritize into the Q2 roadmap. Propose we break into: 1) Short-term: hotfix routing policy review and automated rollback (size: S) 2) Medium: model onboarding validation to run long-seq perf tests (size: M) 3) Long-term: runtime memory allocator improvements or alternate quantization strategies (size: L).

sam-sre: I volunteer to own (1) with help from infra. For (2) I'll raise a ticket with eng-ml and product to define test harness.

irene-oncall: adding more detail for S/M/L sizing: S = ~3 engineer-days to add canary routing rule + tests; M = ~2-3 sprints to add long-seq evals and integrate in CI; L = architecture work, ~1-2 quarters depending on approach.

incident-bot: NEW TODO created: 1812345678-1 "hotfix: auto-routing rollback + canary test" owner=sam-sre size=S due=2026-03-22

incident-bot: NEW TODO created: 1812345678-2 "onboard long-seq perf tests for model variants" owner=eng-ml size=M due=2026-04-30

incident-bot: NEW TODO created: 1812345678-3 "evaluate runtime allocator / quant strategy" owner=eng-runtime size=L due=2026-06-30

mike-product: prioritize (1) as P0 for this quarter; (2) as P1 and tie to model onboarding initiative; (3) to R&D backlog but add a milestone for next quarter planning.

sam-sre: I'll start a minimally scoped RFC for hotfix automation today. Ping me for pairing.

lucy-opsbot: customer comms: draft posted in #customer-comms for review. Suggest sending interim note to affected customers summarizing mitigation and next steps.

irene-oncall: quick follow-ups before handoff: - confirm postmortem owner (sam-sre?) - capture any missed alert thresholds - tag all artifacts in the incident ticket (logs, trace links, dashboards).

mike-product: I'll be the postmortem facilitator in the meeting. Sam is OK to be the PM owner for remediation. Lucy will coordinate customer comms.

irene-oncall: handing off to daytime oncall @sam-sre for post-incident coordination. Closing live mitigation channel.

sam-sre: ack. I'll take ownership of the postmortem and action tracking. First steps: consolidate timeline and link todos to sprint backlog.

mike-product: thanks team. Add a short blurb to the quarterly planning doc to ensure (2) and (3) get visibility in roadmap sync.

lucy-opsbot: summary: incident mitigated, postmortem scheduled, 3 action items created (S/M/L) with owners and target due dates. Customer comms draft in review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: status -> mitigated. See postmortem thread #postmortems/1812345678 for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
